AgentRefView.description:
The agent that wrote a message: its kind and the session it runs in.
The session is one of the same tree, which a reader of this session
reads too: a sub-agent's report names the child, a child's objective
its parent.
AgentRefView.title: AgentRefView

AgentSessionControl.description:
The controls a person sends a session out of band. A decision on one
tool call is a route of its own.
AgentSessionControl.title: AgentSessionControl

AgentSessionModelUsageView.description:
What a session's model calls used, as each provider reported it, per
model and in total.
AgentSessionModelUsageView.title: AgentSessionModelUsageView

AgentSessionPageView.description:
One page of root sessions, newest first. `next_cursor` fetches the
next page and is null on the last one.
AgentSessionPageView.title: AgentSessionPageView

AgentSessionUsageView.description:
A page of a session's usage records, oldest first, with the rollup of
each loop, in the order it first called, and of the whole session. The
rollups cover every record, whatever the page; `has_more_loops` says the
session ran more loops than `loops` holds. With `next_cursor`, the next
page of `items` starts there.
AgentSessionUsageView.title: AgentSessionUsageView

AgentSessionView.description:
A session: its kind, its title, and its status, which follows its
steps. `pending` while an input waits for a run, `running` while a run
holds its loop, `parked` while the loop waits, `idle` when no loop is
open. A sub-agent names the session that spawned it, and every session
the root of its tree. `visibility` says who sees it: every member of the
org, who may join it, or its creator and its `participants` alone.
`steerer` is the person whose messages instruct it, its creator until a
hand-off; a participant's message is data. A sub-agent names none: its
parent steers it, and it is seen as its root is. `deleted_at` is set
only on the answer to a delete: a deleted session is on no read until it
is restored.
AgentSessionView.title: AgentSessionView

AgentStepPageView.description:
One page of a session's history, after the seq the request named.
With `has_more`, the next page starts after the last step's seq.
AgentStepPageView.title: AgentStepPageView

AgentStepUsageView.description:
What a model call used, as its provider reported it, in disjoint
classes, so no token is counted twice.
AgentStepUsageView.title: AgentStepUsageView

AgentStepView.description:
One step of a session's history, in its order. `text` is what it
says: a message's words, a model's answer, a tool's result. A model
response also says what it thought (`thinking`) and the calls it made
(`tool_uses`); a tool response names the call it answers
(`tool_use_id`). Each of these is the step's content: where it is gone,
its session's key revoked or its content never kept here, each is empty
as `text` is. The rest is its header's, by type: the agent that wrote a
message, on a message an agent wrote (`agent`); the tools a model
response called, why it stopped, and what it used; a tool call's tool,
the id of the call it runs, and the class of its failure; a control's
command; a park; a loop's outcome, and its cause when the engine names
one, such as the setup command that failed and its exit code; the
snapshot a `snapshotted` step names, or a restore starts from. A message
names its `author`, and `participant` says it is a participant's, data,
never an instruction. A `switched` step that moved the steer names the
new `steerer`, and one that switched who sees the session its
`visibility`.
AgentStepView.title: AgentStepView

Among.description:
Which root sessions a person's list holds: sub-agents are read
through their tree.
Among.title: Among

ApprovalPageView.description:
The calls held across one page of the tenant's parked sessions, by
session id. `next_cursor` reads the next page of sessions and is null
on the last one; a page may hold no call and still have a next.
ApprovalPageView.title: ApprovalPageView

ApprovalView.description:
A tool call held for a person's decision: its session, the seq it is
decided at, its tool and the class of power it exercises, and the
principal it runs under. Its input stays in the history; the request
names only its hash.
ApprovalView.title: ApprovalView

BoundsView.description:
The bounds a session runs under: its kind's loop limits, the deadline
its kind gives a tree it roots, and its tree's record.
BoundsView.title: BoundsView

ControlRequest.description:
A control. An interrupt names the seq of the tool request it stops,
and a restore the id of a snapshot the session's history names, which
its workspace's next prepare starts from; no other control names
either.
ControlRequest.title: ControlRequest

DeadlineRequest.description:
The deadline the session's tree shares, set whole: an instant, or
null to take it away. One past now, or none, unlocks every session of
the tree parked on the deadline. An instant with no offset names no
moment, so it is refused.
DeadlineRequest.title: DeadlineRequest

DecisionRequest.description:
A person's decision on the tool call at a seq. A denial's note is what
the model reads.
DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest

FillUsageView.description:
What one model, at its provider, used in the session's calls: the
calls that answered, and their tokens by class, no token counted
twice.
FillUsageView.title: FillUsageView

GiveBackRequest.description:
What the person who held the environment did there, which the model
reads as their message when the loop goes on.
GiveBackRequest.title: GiveBackRequest

JobCompletionRequest.description:
How a job ended, from the system it ran on: the tool's handle for
the work, its result as text, and the class of its failure when it
failed. A job that spends is counted at its whole hold: no cost is
taken over the wire.
JobCompletionRequest.title: JobCompletionRequest

LoopLimitsView.description:
The bounds of one loop of the session's kind: the model calls before
the step guard parks it for a person, the tool errors or identical
calls in a row that end it, the nudges it gives, and how long one run
drives it before handing it on.
LoopLimitsView.title: LoopLimitsView

MessageRequest.description:
A message to the session, said in the caller's name. It wakes an idle
session, and a running loop reads it at its next model request.
MessageRequest.title: MessageRequest

ParkView.description:
Why a parked loop waits, what clears it, and when it tries again by
itself; a park only a person clears has no time, and neither has a park
in line, which names where it stands. `cause` says why in words when the
engine can name it, such as a workspace base still being built, or a
key a provider refused and who must act. A hand-over names `holder`,
the user who holds the environment and alone gives it back.
ParkView.title: ParkView

PrincipalRequest.description:
Who steers the session from here: a participant its steerer hands it
to. Left out, the caller takes it.
PrincipalRequest.title: PrincipalRequest

QuestionView.description:
What a session asks of a person now: a park on a person that is no
call's decision, such as a step guard to lift, a deadline to move, or a
principal to name. `unlock` is what clears it, sent as a control; `seq`
is the step that parked it.
QuestionView.title: QuestionView

SnapshotView.description:
A workspace's snapshot a step names: its id, which a restore names,
the hash of its bytes keyed by its session, its size in bytes, and the
workspace it was taken from.
SnapshotView.title: SnapshotView

StartAgentSessionRequest.description:
A session to start on the latest version of a kind the product runs,
in an agent project of the caller's tenant. Outside a local stack a session
starts in an agent project or not at all.
StartAgentSessionRequest.title: StartAgentSessionRequest

StopReason.description:
Why a model's response stopped, as the wire carries it: the model
providers' own reason, by value. A refusal is a response the agent kind
handles, never a provider error.
StopReason.title: StopReason

ToolCallPageView.description:
One page of a session's tool calls, in order, after the seq the
request named. With `has_more`, the next page starts after the last
call's seq.
ToolCallPageView.title: ToolCallPageView

ToolCallView.description:
One tool call of a session: its request, a person's decision on it
when one was asked, and its response once it answered. A call with no
response is open: held for a decision, or running.
ToolCallView.title: ToolCallView

ToolOutputPageView.description:
A page of what a session keeps whole outside its window, such as a
long tool result: its characters from `start`, the whole tool output's
length, and whether more follow.
ToolOutputPageView.title: ToolOutputPageView

ToolUseView.description:
One call a model response made: its id, which the call's request and
response name, the tool, and what the tool was asked, each string cut
at `MAX_SHOWN`.
ToolUseView.title: ToolUseView

TreeBoundsView.description:
What the session's tree shares: how deep and how many sub-agents it
may have, how many run at once, the one deadline, and how many were
spawned so far.
TreeBoundsView.title: TreeBoundsView

UsageRecordView.description:
One model call a provider billed, as the ledger keeps it: ids, tokens
by disjoint class, reference cost in millionths (null when no price
applied), the provider's latency, and the labels of what served it. It
holds no content, so it reads the same in every storage mode. `agent_step_id`
is the call's response step; `spend_hold_id` its hold; `tree_id` the
session's tree; `kind_version` the agent kind's version the session
ran. `settled_whole` marks a call whose usage was never reported whole
(a broken stream, a lost run): its cost is its whole hold, and its
tokens are what a partial reply reported, else 0.
UsageRecordView.title: UsageRecordView

UsageRollupView.description:
The sum of some records. `unpriced` counts the calls no price applied
to, whose cost is in no figure here: a rollup with any is a floor.
`settled_whole` counts the calls settled at their whole hold, whose cost
is in `cost_micros` at the hold, as the ledger counts it.
UsageRollupView.title: UsageRollupView

VisibilityRequest.description:
Who sees the session from here: every member of the org, or its
creator and its participants alone.
VisibilityRequest.title: VisibilityRequest

WaitLineParkView.description:
The wait line a loop stands in: the request, what it asked for (a
kind, and the leasable resource when it named one), its place (1 is next
in some wait line it stands in), and the estimate of its wait.
WaitLineParkView.title: WaitLineParkView

get.description:
What one session's model calls used and cost, in every storage mode
(ADR 1014). Requires the read permission.

The answer is a `AgentSessionUsageView`: `agent_session_id`; `items`, a page of the
session's usage records, oldest first, each with `id`, `created_at`,
`spend_hold_id`, `agent_session_id`, `tree_id`, `loop_id`, `agent_step_id` (the call's
response step), `agent_kind`, `kind_version`, `role`, `provider`, `model`, `input_tokens`,
`cache_read_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`, `output_tokens`,
`thinking_tokens`, `cost_micros` (reference cost in millionths, null when
no price applied), `latency_ms`, and `settled_whole` (a call whose usage
was never reported whole, counted at its whole hold, its tokens partial
at most); `next_cursor`, the next page's `cursor`, or null; `loops`, one
`{loop_id, rollup}` per loop in the order it first called;
`has_more_loops`; and `total`, the session's rollup. A rollup holds
`calls`, the five token classes, `cost_micros`, `unpriced` (calls no
price applied to, whose cost no figure holds), `settled_whole` (calls
counted at their whole hold), and `latency_ms`. The rollups cover every
record, whatever the page.

A record holds ids, counts, money, a duration, and labels, and no
content. `404 not_found` for an unknown org, and for a session the org
holds no record of, which is how another tenant's session reads.

The org's root sessions in a status, or in any, newest first, a page
at a time: the ones the caller made or takes part in (`mine`), or every
one they see (`visible`).

post.description: A session on the kind, idle until a message wakes it.

delete.description:
An idle session marked deleted: it answers as one that never existed
until it is restored, and its retention ends the chance.

get.description: The calls the session holds for a person's decision.

post.description:
An idle session archived: it keeps what arrives and wakes for nothing
until a person's message brings it back.

get.description: The loop limits of the session's kind, and its tree's bounds.

post.description: An approval or a denial of the tool call at `request_seq`, as stored.

get.description: The sessions this one spawned, a page at a time by id.

post.description: The control as stored, out of band: it never waits behind a message.

put.description:
The deadline of the session's tree, moved for every session of it.
One past now, or null, unlocks each session parked on the deadline.

post.description:
The holder, in person, gives the environment back with what they
did there, and the loop goes on: 403 for anyone else.

How the job of `key` ended, from the system it ran on: the loop that
waits on it goes on. 404 for a job the session does not wait on.
The message as stored, durable when this answers.

delete.description:
`user_id` takes no part in the session: its creator removes anyone,
and a participant leaves on their own. 403 for anyone else, 409 for
its steerer until the steer is handed on.

put.description:
`user_id` takes part in the session: any member joins an org-wide
one, and its creator adds anyone. A private one is joined only by whom
its creator adds and by its steerer: 403 for any other self-join,
`manage_agent_sessions` included, and for anyone else's add.

The steer moves, recorded as a step: its steerer hands it to the
participant the body names, or with no body the caller takes it, for a
steerer who lapsed with `manage_agent_sessions`. Its tool calls run under the
steerer, and a loop parked on a principal who no longer holds goes on.
403 for anyone else, 422 for one who takes no part in it.

get.description: What the session waits on a person for, other than a call's decision.

post.description: A deleted session back as it was, with its history.

get.description: The history in order, strictly after `after_seq`.

post.description:
The caller, in person, takes the environment to work by hand: the
loop parks on a hand-over they hold. 409 when another person holds it.

get.description:
Each tool call with its decision and its answer, strictly after
`after_seq`.

A page of what the session keeps whole outside its window, from the
character at `start`: a tool output is written once, so no character's
place moves between pages. The policy's page bounds `limit`.
The tokens the session's model calls used, per model and in total.

put.description:
Its creator switches who sees the session, recorded as a step: 403
for anyone else.

tags.description:
Agent session routes: start a session on a kind, list the ones a
person takes part in or sees, and a session's children, a page at a time,
read one, archive, delete, and restore it, join one or leave it, switch
who sees it, hand its steer on, send it a message or a control, decide a
tool call it waits on, clear the park a person clears, and read its
history and its tool outputs a page at a time. A session's derived reads
follow: what it asks of a person, the calls it holds for a decision, its
bounds, its tool calls, and what its model calls used. Each function is
one call into the agent
sessions service; every create runs under the idempotency record, so a
retried send is one step. The loop runs in the session runner: a route
writes what a person said and answers once it is durable. A session the
caller does not see answers 404, as one that never existed.

Each park a person clears has its route, held to the permission its
manager checks, and clearing it wakes the session: a message answers a
question, a decision an approval, a moved deadline the deadline, an
assignment a principal who no longer holds, a giving back the hand-over
its holder holds, a job's completion its job, and an unlock the step
guard, a spender, a lost workspace, and a key or a price fixed outside.

On the operator plane (`routers/tenancy.py`), an operator token that may
read reads what one session's model calls used and cost.
tags.name: agent_sessions
